claims.bridge_target_proxy_reconstruction_gate: Compatibility name for a forward target-role test: prior build plus shared canonical dimensions must improve on build alone; it is not cross-sport validation.

claims.training_cohort: Eligible and positive-opportunity low-sample labels may train with empirical opportunity/coverage weights. Frozen evaluation remains eligible-only, and rows must satisfy the deployed build and fixed-dimension requirements.
